race.comment: VENUS INVICTA (2) gets the nod on debut with Capitalist speed in the pedigree and a Group 1-winning trainer in Kelly Schweida behind her. Doomben trial win in readiness was sharp. Looks set for a bright start. HIGHWIRE QUEEN (1) looks the main danger, a Trapeze Artist filly from Jami Lady. Gets the key booking of Thompson off a trial win in readiness. MISHANI KIMITSU (5) jumps from a wide draw, so will likely settle back in the ruck and be warming late. Is another that impressed in her lead-up work. BETTER BE DONE (9) comes through the same trial as VENUS INVICTA coming in and comes from a successful family with all of her siblings being race winners. Not to be discounted.
